targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_tank" and r.tank_id == "tank1" and r._field == "level_pct")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_tank" and r.tank_id == "tank1" and r._field == "volume_liters")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_tank" and r.tank_id == "tank1" and r._field == "level_cm")
  |> last()

import "math"
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_tank" and r.tank_id == "tank1" and r._field == "volume_liters")
  |> sort(columns:["_time"])
  |> difference()
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: math.abs(x: r._value)}))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_tank" and r.tank_id == "tank2" and r._field == "level_pct")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_tank" and r.tank_id == "tank2" and r._field == "volume_liters")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_tank" and r.tank_id == "tank2" and r._field == "level_pct")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns:["source"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_tank" and r.tank_id == "tank2" and r._field == "volume_liters")
  |> sort(columns:["_time"])
  |> difference()
  |> mean()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_tank" and r.tank_id == "tank1" and r._field == "volume_liters")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_tank" and r.tank_id == "tank2" and r._field == "volume_liters")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "water_tank" and r.tank_id == "tank2" and r.source == "rain" and r._field == "volume_liters")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
